name: techdrawai
description: Turn a product photo or a written description into a dimensioned technical drawing, then into DXF/DWG for CAD, an STL or a 3D model.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a photo of a real product, or a written description with sizes, into a clean technical drawing in ChatGPT. TechDraw AI draws the front, side and top views on an ISO or ANSI sheet with dimensions, and hands you files you can open in AutoCAD, Fusion, SolidWorks, a laser cutter or a 3D printer.

With TechDraw AI, you can:

• Send a photo of a part, a piece of furniture or a product and get a dimensioned orthographic drawing on an A3 or A4 sheet.

• Draft to your trade: furniture shop drawings, garment technical flats for a tech pack, machine parts with tolerances, sheet metal with bend lines and a flat pattern, woodworking plans, and parts for 3D printing.

• Describe a part in words, like an L bracket with its sizes and holes, and get a true-to-size drawing.

• Convert a drawing, sketch or logo to DXF and DWG for CAD, laser and CNC.

• Turn line art or a logo into a 3D-printable STL.

• Render the product from a drawing as a photoreal studio image.

• Turn a product photo or a drawing into a 3D model you can download as GLB and STL.

Connect your TechDraw AI account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Make a technical drawing of this product photo
Draw a steel L bracket, legs 80 and 60 mm, 40 wide, 5 thick
Convert this drawing to DXF and DWG for AutoCAD

positive.description: Turn a product photo into a technical drawing (core case)
positive.prompt: Use TechDraw AI to make a technical drawing of this pendant lamp: https://techdrawai.com/hero/compare/lamp-photo.webp
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one dimensioned ISO drawing of the lamp on an A3 sheet with front, side and top views. The TechDraw AI card shows the drawing, buttons for DXF, a photoreal render and a 3D model, and reports 5 credits used. Takes about 20 to 40 seconds.

positive.description: Trade-specific drawing: sheet metal with bend lines and a flat pattern
positive.prompt: Use TechDraw AI to make a sheet metal drawing of this bracket, with the flat pattern for laser cutting: https://techdrawai.com/verticals/sheet-metal-photo.webp
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_technical_drawing with trade sheet-metal. Returns one dimensioned drawing of the bracket with material thickness, bend lines and a flat pattern view; the card offers DXF as the next step and reports 5 credits used. Takes about 30 to 50 seconds.

positive.description: Draw a part from a written description with sizes
positive.prompt: Use TechDraw AI to draw a steel L bracket: legs 80 mm and 60 mm, 40 mm wide, 5 mm thick, two 8.5 mm holes in each leg.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a true-to-size drawing of the bracket with the stated sizes and holes dimensioned in mm, and reports 5 credits used. Takes about 30 seconds.

positive.description: Convert a drawing to CAD files (free)
positive.prompt: Use TechDraw AI to convert this drawing to DXF and DWG, 200 mm wide: https://techdrawai.com/hero/compare/bracket-drawing.webp
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a DXF and a DWG download scaled to 200 mm wide, listed in the TechDraw AI card. Free: no credits are spent. Takes a few seconds.

positive.description: Turn a product photo into a 3D model (async job)
positive.prompt: Use TechDraw AI to make a 3D model of this armchair: https://techdrawai.com/hero/compare/armchair-photo.webp
positive.expected_behavior: photo_to_3d returns a job id and states 80 credits were charged; the card shows progress and then offers GLB and STL downloads with a preview. If the card cannot update itself, check_job returns the result. Takes about 2 to 4 minutes.

negative.description: Artwork, not a technical drawing: TechDraw AI does not make illustrations or logos
negative.prompt: Draw a cute cartoon cat for my daughter's birthday card.

negative.description: An engineering question that needs an answer, not a drawing
negative.prompt: What is the difference between first-angle and third-angle projection?

negative.description: Buying parts: TechDraw AI does not sell or price hardware
negative.prompt: Where can I buy M8 stainless steel bolts in bulk?
